description: This file defines a PHP class 'Zend_Http_UserAgent_Validator' which extends another class and provides functionality to detect specific user agent signatures related to validators, as well as identifying the browser type as 'validator'. It includes static properties for signatures and methods for matching user agents and retrieving the browser type.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_Validator
classes.description: A class that extends Zend_Http_UserAgent_Desktop to identify and match user agents related to validators and retrieve the validator type.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Static method to determine if a user agent matches known validator signatures.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the string 'validator' indicating the browser type.
